info.title: SCAMurai API
info.description: Evidence-based financial scam awareness API. Analyses explain the promises a message makes, the action it requests, and what a decoded instruction actually authorizes. Signals are risk indicators, not proof of fraud or theft.

get.description: Liveness probe with stable fields. It performs no external calls and exposes no configuration secrets.

post.summary: Analyse a text message for scam indicators
post.description: Analyses a plain-text message with a fixed, deterministic rule baseline (`scam_text_rules` v1.0.0) and static link checks (`url_static_rules` v1.0.0). Every signal quotes exact excerpts of the submitted text and carries its rule provenance. Links are parsed but never opened, resolved, or fetched. The 0-100 risk score is the capped sum of documented rule weights; it is an indicator, not a probability or proof of fraud. No LLM, database, or message storage is involved.

APIErrorBody.title: APIErrorBody
APIErrorBody.description: Inner error object shared by every failure response.

APIErrorDetail.title: APIErrorDetail
APIErrorDetail.description:
One field-level or request-level error detail.

Never carries the submitted value: request bodies may contain sensitive
text and must not be reflected back in errors.

APIErrorResponse.title: APIErrorResponse
APIErrorResponse.description: Single envelope returned for every 4xx/5xx API response.

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Known gaps in the evidence available to the analysis.

AnalysisLimitations.title: AnalysisLimitations
AnalysisLimitations.description:
Explicit caveats that must accompany an analysis response.

Limitations are part of the API contract, not an optional nicety: missing
metadata, unverified URLs, or undecoded call data all belong here.

AnalysisStatus.title: AnalysisStatus
AnalysisStatus.description: How complete a future analysis result is.

CancelRequest.title: CancelRequest
CancelRequest.description: Empty request object for the optional cancellation endpoint.

CounterfactualRequest.title: CounterfactualRequest
CounterfactualRequest.description: Request one supported profile-level counterfactual rerun.

Environment.title: Environment
Environment.description: Deployment environment, used only for diagnostics and CORS defaults.

ErrorCode.title: ErrorCode
ErrorCode.description: Stable machine-readable error codes for the error envelope.

EvidenceSource.title: EvidenceSource
EvidenceSource.description:
Where the facts behind a signal came from.

Sources are kept explicit so decoded blockchain facts can never be
silently replaced by model output.

priority.title: Priority
priority.description: Lower numbers should be read first.

RecommendedAction.title: RecommendedAction
RecommendedAction.description: One ordered, non-executing action for the recipient.

RiskLevel.title: RiskLevel
RiskLevel.description:
Aggregate, rule-derived risk indicator.

``unknown`` is a first-class value: absent or ambiguous evidence must not
be converted into a numeric or arbitrary risk score. A high level is a
reason to pause and verify, never proof of fraud or theft.

rule_set.title: Rule Set
rule_set.description: Name of the rule collection that produced the signal.

version.title: Version
version.description: Version of the rule collection, e.g. ``1.0.0``.

RuleProvenance.title: RuleProvenance
RuleProvenance.description:
Where a deterministic signal came from.

``rule_id`` matches a documented rule. ``rule_set`` and ``version`` let a
client tell when the rule baseline changed. Signals produced by other
sources (for example decoded calldata) may omit provenance.

ScamCategory.title: ScamCategory
ScamCategory.description:
Dominant indicator family reported for an analysis.

Categories describe the *message pattern* that produced the strongest
evidence. They are not accusations against a sender, and ``none`` means no
documented indicator matched.

ScoreContribution.title: ScoreContribution
ScoreContribution.description:
Points one signal contributed before the total was capped.

A URL-path finding that merely corroborates a text finding contributes
``0`` so the same theme is not counted twice across sources.

method.title: Method
method.description: Stable name of the scoring method.

ScoringBreakdown.title: ScoringBreakdown
ScoringBreakdown.description:
Transparent arithmetic behind ``risk_score``.

``raw_total`` is the sum of per-rule points; ``applied_total`` is that sum
capped at 100. ``capped`` is true only when the cap changed the total.

ServiceStatus.title: ServiceStatus
ServiceStatus.description: Coarse health of the API process.

Severity.title: Severity
Severity.description: How strongly a single signal should draw the user's attention.

code.title: Code
code.description: Stable machine-readable identifier for the rule or check.

explanation.title: Explanation
explanation.description: Why the evidence matters, without claiming proven fraud.

evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.description: Concrete observations supporting the signal. For text rules these are exact excerpts of the submitted message.

rule.description: Provenance of the rule, when the signal came from one.

Signal.title: Signal
Signal.description: One evidence-backed finding produced by a deterministic rule or decoder.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language tag of the message, e.g. ``en`` or ``en-IN``.

TextAnalysisRequest.title: TextAnalysisRequest
TextAnalysisRequest.description:
Request body for ``POST /api/v1/analyze``.

Only plain text is analysed in this version. ``language`` is a BCP 47-style
tag (``en``, ``en-IN``, ``hi``); the rule baseline is English-first.

TextAnalysisResponse.title: TextAnalysisResponse
TextAnalysisResponse.description:
Response body for ``POST /api/v1/analyze``.

The submitted message itself is not echoed back. ``scan_id`` identifies
this analysis run only; nothing is stored server-side.
